summary: decision D01: P06 rescope: spec internalization + dogfood instead of plan §4 'Hardening + GA'

payload.summary: P06 rescope: spec internalization + dogfood instead of plan §4 'Hardening + GA'
payload.rationale: Plan §4 lists P06 as Hardening + GA (Linux polish, golden scenarios, release tag). Phase 6 reframed to (a) internalize the v0.1 design spec into docs/, (b) dogfood eawf on its own repo, (c) ship the v0.1 PR. The displaced hardening work is captured in v0.2 backlog items B001 (Linux CI matrix), B009 (golden scenarios), B010 (v0.1.0 release tag).
alternatives: Keep plan §4 P06 scope verbatim; defer spec internalization to v0.1.1

summary: decision D02: B019 audit-check DSL: yaml declarative + check-kind registry

payload.summary: B019 audit-check DSL: yaml declarative + check-kind registry
payload.rationale: Bottleneck is non-coders authoring audits, not expressing arbitrary logic. YAML + registry of built-in kinds (file_exists, regex_match, json_path_value, pytest_pass, coverage_min, numeric_threshold, command_exit_zero) lets check-authors stay in YAML; new kinds are a code change. Hybrid escape hatch can come later if real example pushes against the registry.
alternatives: python-callable-only (every check needs a code change)

summary: decision D03: B020 hypothesis lifecycle: audit-link required at set-verdict only

payload.summary: B020 hypothesis lifecycle: audit-link required at set-verdict only
payload.rationale: Audit link gates the commitment, not the exploration. Forcing audit at hypothesis open time forces premature audit design; making it fully optional fails the verify-before-claim rule. Permissive open + required audit on set-verdict matches the dogfood workflow.
alternatives: audit link required at hypothesis open time

summary: decision D04: B021 artifact registry: sha256 mandatory for files, optional for URLs

payload.summary: B021 artifact registry: sha256 mandatory for files, optional for URLs
payload.rationale: Local file integrity is cheap to enforce; URL integrity is a different problem (provenance + fetch policy). Mandatory-everywhere couples the registry to network state at registration. eawf artifact verify recomputes on demand for both cases.

summary: decision D05: B022 integrity runner: auto on phase close + opt-in eawf validate --integrity

payload.summary: B022 integrity runner: auto on phase close + opt-in eawf validate --integrity
payload.rationale: Phase close is the natural integrity boundary; manual run is the escape hatch for debugging. Every-mutation is too slow on hot paths like wave dispatch; manual-only is easy to forget. Failures block phase close; --force requires audit reason so the bypass is recorded.

summary: decision D06: Defer retro audit-verdict + backlog priority-bumps to P07 CLI completeness

payload.summary: Defer retro audit-verdict + backlog priority-bumps to P07 CLI completeness
payload.rationale: v0.1 CLI lacks 'eawf audit set-verdict' and 'eawf backlog set-priority' verbs. Hand-editing state.json would violate AGENTS.md rule 4 (state CLI is the only mutator). Safer to ship the verbs in P07 and do the retro-stamping (A01..A06 verdicts; B015/B017 P2->P1) at P07 closeout in one pass.
alternatives: ship the verbs as a P06 follow-up commit before tagging v0.1.0

summary: decision D07: PR merge strategy: rebase-and-merge; never squash, never merge-commit

payload.summary: PR merge strategy: rebase-and-merge; never squash, never merge-commit
payload.rationale: Squash collapses per-wave/per-commit history into a single fat commit on main, losing the symbol-prefixed audit trail (e.g. [P06-W05] [P06-CORE]) that AGENTS.md commit-prefix rule and the wave/audit chain depend on for reconstructibility from git log. Rebase-merge preserves linear, individual commits with their original messages — matches the cherry-pick discipline that already feeds the long-running phase branch. Merge-commits forbidden by repo settings (mergeCommitAllowed=false). Default for all phase PRs unless explicitly overridden.
alternatives: squash-merge (collapses history; rejected — incident 2026-05-10 PR #3 squashed by ship skill, reverted via force-push, redone as rebase-merge in PR #4)

summary: decision D08: Defer PR-cadence policy change until v0.2.0 ship

payload.summary: Defer PR-cadence policy change until v0.2.0 ship
payload.rationale: User proposed shifting from per-phase PR to review-driven + version-bump PR mid-v0.2. Mid-stream workflow change = state-of-record drift risk; defer re-evaluation to v0.2.0 cut, when iter/phase aggregation pattern is fully exercised.
alternatives: Adopt review-driven PR cadence immediately (rejected: mid-game policy churn)
Lock per-phase PR forever (rejected: pre-decides v0.2.0 retro)

summary: decision D09: Defer B005 PyPI publish to v0.3

payload.summary: Defer B005 PyPI publish to v0.3
payload.rationale: v0.2 scope locked at P13; PyPI publish needs maintainer-track decision + CI release gating + tag-driven workflow not yet in place. Park behind tag v0.2.0 ship and reopen as v0.3 epic.
alternatives: Ship PyPI in P13 alongside tag v0.2.0 (rejected: scope creep)

summary: decision D10: Revisit D08 — keep one-PR-per-phase cadence through v0.2 close

payload.summary: Revisit D08 — keep one-PR-per-phase cadence through v0.2 close
payload.rationale: D08 deferred the cadence policy revisit to v0.2.0 ship. Reviewed at P13 open: one-PR-per-phase produced clean rebase-merge history across P07..P12 and aligns with AGENTS.md phase lifecycle. Keep cadence; reopen for v0.3 only if multi-phase PRs become necessary.
alternatives: Multi-phase rolling PR (rejected: rebase history becomes noisy, hard to revert one phase)

summary: decision D11: P13 scope lock: 7 waves (W01-W07); no further adds without ADR

payload.summary: P13 scope lock: 7 waves (W01-W07); no further adds without ADR
payload.rationale: P13 is the v0.2.0 ship-gate phase. Scope = backlog hygiene (W01) + 4 net-new features (W02 B009, W04 B019, W05 B015, W07 B017) + B042 (W03) + version bump (W06) + CORE final. Additional waves block tag and re-trigger CI; add via decision ADR only.
alternatives: Roll v0.3 features into P13 (rejected: violates phase-bounded scope, delays tag)

payload.summary: v0.3 harness scope: Claude + Codex + OpenCode only

Defer codex TOML emit to v0.4 alongside the codex adapter

summary: decision D28: IntentBrief field set ratified per W24 audit

payload.summary: IntentBrief field set ratified per W24 audit
payload.rationale: W24 audit ratified the structured intent shape (problem + desired_outcome required; planned_steps / risks / priority_rationale optional) over the prior goal / motivation / success_signal triad. Operator approved the migration via AUQ on 2026-05-28. The W52 wave was split into three sequential waves (W59 additive schema, W60 consumer migration with back-compat fallback, W61 atomic drop of the legacy fields + CLI flags) so the call graph stayed green through each stage. Post-W61 every consumer reads problem / desired_outcome directly; legacy fields have no remaining producer and would only invite re-introduction drift.
alternatives: Keep both field sets indefinitely with renderer preference for the audited pair (rejected: extra-forbid no longer pinned the shape and the renderer fallback code paths invited drift).
Atomic single-wave swap without the staged migration (rejected: high blast radius across renderers / TUI / loggers / builders — staged migration kept the tree green).

summary: decision D29: W57 criterion step-0 ratified as labeling reference

payload.summary: W57 criterion step-0 ratified as labeling reference
payload.rationale: Audit A42 follow-up flagged W57 success_criteria text 'SubagentSpec._render_workflow prepends step 0=eawf wave claim' as unmet. Operator 2026-05-28 AUQ confirmed the criterion was a labeling reference to the commit-prefix step (W57 renumbered it as step 4 of the 5-step body), not a literal directive. Subagent dispatch already wires claim via executor system prompt outside _render_workflow; a literal step 0 would duplicate. W57 criterion closed as honored.
alternatives: Reactive wave inserting literal claim step 0 (rejected: duplicates executor system prompt; golden re-pair would also hit snapshot gate).

Heavy dwell-on surfaces become full-screen Textual MODES reached by palette verb + collision-free digit accelerator; SCOPE (w/r/u) and MODE are orthogonal axes; modals demote to transient confirm/form/peek; Config retired (reachable via c modal). Ratified by 3 AUQ rounds 2026-05-30 (tui-chassis brief); restores brief parity after the P29 propose thinned the digit map (incident 2026-06-02-tui-brief-criteria-drift).
alternatives: Keep push_screen/switch_screen scope-as-screen (rejected: conflates scope+mode axes, forces new surfaces into modal-soup)
Keep as-built 9-mode map with autopilot at digit 9 (rejected: diverges from ratified brief, buries the spawn cockpit at the last digit)

summary: decision D30: I08 QC gate is deterministic-first with a jury for the true residual

payload.summary: I08 QC gate is deterministic-first with a jury for the true residual
payload.rationale: UI/UX behaviour cannot be fully pinned by deterministic tests so a markdown-spec LLM-jury scores the residual. The gameability red-team proved naive jury gates are gameable via provenance-free evidence and deterministic-decidable rubric items; so deterministic gates rank first, the jury judges only the true residual on provenance-pinned evidence, and discrimination is proven by a deterministic canned-ballot gate not a jury. Producer and jury un-idle for the UI/UX band only via a scoped verify block not the global enforce flip.
alternatives: Global enforce flip rejected as too broad for a contained PoC
Sibling rubric file rejected as a second schema to keep in sync
Jury certifying the jury rejected as meta-circular
